data.title: 拉姆 · 床边的书
data.description: 拉姆穿着浴袍倚坐在床头，书本半合在膝上。台灯还亮着，她看向门口，像是在等一句晚安。
data.promptProse: Propped against soft pillows and the dark wooden headboard in her belted ivory bathrobe, Ram rests a half-closed clothbound book lightly across her lap with one hand keeping her place. Hearing quiet footsteps, she lifts her gaze calmly toward the bedroom doorway under the gentle pool of the bedside lamp. Warm amber lamplight traces her cheek, the folded sheets, and the wooden nightstand beside her.
data.animaCaption: Leaning back against the headboard in her ivory bathrobe with a half-closed book resting on her lap, Ram looks calmly toward the doorway. Warm bedside lamplight softens the pillows and shadows of the quiet bedroom.
